sn55.10:3.3: The commentary attributes the large number of deaths to a recent plague (ahivātaroga, “viper’s breath disease”). This deadly contagion (malaria?) was known to kill off entire families (Kd 1:50.1.1). According to the commentaries, the same disease once afflicted Vesālī, prompting the teaching of the Ratanasutta (Snp 2.1, Kp 6).
